Alternatively, maybe the PDB file doesn't start with the N and CA of GLU A as the first two atoms. Perhaps the first two atoms are part of the same residue, and the order is different. 

Also, the Coder's script correctly uses the formula, so the mistake isn't there. The error must be in the extraction of the coordinates. 

So, the mistake was made by FileSurfer when they extracted the first two atoms' coordinates. They might have taken the wrong atoms, or the order was incorrect, leading to the wrong distance calculation.
